images.review: Read-only participant location: complete long location wraps over multiple lines; no edit pencil. Upper title tail and bottom local-draft footer are visible. Scrolled viewport intentionally crops earlier title content.

Read-only participant title: large title body and trailing words are readable; first-line top sits under navigation clipping at this scroll position. No editing controls or edit pencil. Full-title first edge is separately visible in segment 0.
Read-only title segment 1: trailing title words including the final word are visible; top is scrolled beneath navigation. Paired with segment 0 rather than claimed as all text on one screen.

Read-only title segment 0: title starts with a complete first word and continues through the long natural wrap; final word is partly outside the lower scroll viewport. Segment 1 supplies its full view.

Saved metadata/private draft: location tail, divider, full candidate dates, gray collection caption/time zone, zero submitted responders and selected 09:00 cell with count zero are visible. Local half-hour draft footer remains unsent and its two owner actions fit.
Saved owner location: long value wraps naturally and the final location words are readable above the footer; light pencil indicates editability. Footer still shows unsent restored half-hour draft.
Saved owner title: full long title and light pencil are visible; location begins below. Text is naturally tall and requires scrolling, without ellipsis. Footer remains distinct.

Location-entry action capture: location label and three-line field tail/caret are readable above the keyboard accessory. Only the top rounded edges of Cancel/Save are visible; their text and most of the buttons are behind the system prediction/accessory panel. This image does not visually pass complete-action visibility.

Location-field targeted capture: activity-name label and its three-line field tail are clear, then location label and first two visible location lines. Lower location content/background lies behind the keyboard prediction/accessory panel; this image does not show the complete location field.

Title-field targeted capture: activity-name label and complete three-line visible field tail are clear. Location label/upper lines below are visible, while its lower part is behind the system input panel; no full location-field claim.

Initial location entry: title field tail, location label and three location tail lines/caret are readable; location chrome lower edge runs into the system keyboard accessory area. Buttons are below the shown usable content area.

concrete_visibility_gap.description: In the original 1284×2778 PNGs, the prediction/accessory panel begins near y=1743, above the keyboard key area. In action capture 7 the buttons begin near y=1723, so the panel covers their text and most of their bounds. Target capture 8 also places the lower location field behind that panel.
concrete_visibility_gap.distinction: This is visible system keyboard/accessory occlusion of scrollable content, not the AssistiveTouch overlay, not intrinsic text truncation and not evidence that stored values were cut.
concrete_visibility_gap.next_evidence: Parent is correcting usable-viewport/reveal tests to include the actual accessory panel. Additional actual scrolled captures are required before declaring complete controls visible.

limitations: Full long title/location need natural scrolling; no requirement or claim that they fit on one screen.

Three-line editable fields show an internally scrolled portion. Exact full saved strings and unchanged availability/invitation data are parent API evidence, not inferred from these partial field views.
Restored-draft footer shows unsent half-hour selection while submitted count remains zero; this does not independently inspect backend state.
AssistiveTouch overlaps small right-side regions in some non-keyboard captures and is separate from the keyboard-accessory issue.
The parent reports a 449.231-second automation pass, but that AX-based result is not substituted for missing actual visual viewport evidence.
Reviewer changed no source and operated no device.

Maximum German location-field title-entry: the fixed location label is visible; the lowest part of the displayed field is occluded by the input assistant. The title label is above the outer scroll viewport at this position. Full field/action visual visibility is not established in this frame.

Maximum German title field: fixed activity-name label, distinct dark field surface and three displayed title lines/caret are readable above the input assistant. Location label is separate below; lower location content is intentionally not all visible at this scroll position.

Maximum German initial title editor: distinct fixed name/location labels and the title field identify the two inputs. Title text wraps within its field; lower location content is behind the keyboard. No all-fields-at-once claim.

Maximum German private draft: complete date/status/timezone wrap, zero-response count, selected 09:00 cell and restored-unsubmitted/half-hour summary are visible. Submit-and-share and final-time actions are distinct. AssistiveTouch overlays only the right side of the grid.

Normal Chinese participant after location tap: full saved two-line title and long location are readable, without owner pencils or an editor/keyboard. Zero responses and restored unsubmitted half-hour selection remain visible.

Normal Chinese participant after title tap: saved title/location remain read-only; no editor or keyboard opens. Date/status/timezone, empty response count and the local unsubmitted selection are readable.

Normal Chinese owner saved private draft: changed title/location, decorative owner pencils, zero responses and selected 09:00 half-hour remain visible. Footer is unsubmitted with separate submit-and-share/final-time controls.
Normal Chinese saved location: complete saved long location wraps on two lines below the title, with separate pencil/share and metadata. No text/control overlap is visible.
Normal Chinese saved title: full saved two-line title and long location, share action, owner pencils, zero-response metadata and unsubmitted draft footer remain readable.

reviewB.visualAcceptance: PARTIAL: normal saved/read-only/draft views and maximum title-field hierarchy are readable. Maximum action visibility and the affected location-field bottom are not visually accepted in indices 11–13.
reviewB.followUp: Parent identified actual SystemInputAssistantView above the keyboard body. The test viewport was corrected using that observed frame; new screenshots are required before maximum action visibility passes. App binary is unchanged.
reviewB.systemOverlays: Keyboard/input assistant occlusion is explicitly recorded above; it is not mistaken for text truncation or a new business-rule defect. AssistiveTouch also overlays a small unrelated grid area.
limitations: Only these 11 of 32 PNGs were viewed in this partition. Long values and editor sections require scrolling; simultaneous first-screen visibility of the entire page is not claimed.
Visible field text can represent the currently scrolled part of a multi-line field; exact full values and zero server availability/invitations are separately API/test evidence.
This partition contains no complete saved long German title top/bottom display-value pair or Calendar endpoint, so those visual scopes are not claimed here.
